display.purpose: Hero wordmarks only. Uppercase, once per page, user-select none.

label.purpose: Badges, nav, footer headings, chips. Uppercase with wide tracking.

shadows.name: violet-hover-glow
shadows.purpose: The only box shadow in the system; hover feedback on featured elements.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Default easing for all UI transitions and press feedback.

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Active state on all interactive elements.

motion.name: typing-dot
motion.purpose: Typing indicator lift; 4px translateY, opacity 0.35 to 1, 150ms stagger.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single action color. Used for 'See our services', 'Start a conversation'.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #6c63ff; color: #fff; padding: 12px 28px; border: none; border-radius: 10px; font-family: 'Noto Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.01em; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1), opacity 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.9; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #00d9ff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Quiet alternative — hairline border, no fill.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: transparent; color: #e8e8ed; padding: 12px 28px; border: 1px solid #1e1e30; border-radius: 10px; font-family: 'Noto Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.01em; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1), background 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #00d9ff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Product/service card. Flat at rest; accent glow blob on hover.
components.html:
SILKLEARN

Knowledge infrastructure that keeps compounding
components.css: .ds-card { position: relative; overflow: hidden; background: #0f0f1a; border: 1px solid #1e1e30; border-radius: 16px; padding: 24px; transition: transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1); } .ds-card:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-card-glow { position: absolute; top: -64px; right: -64px; width: 128px; height: 128px; border-radius: 50%; background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(108,99,255,0.35), transparent 70%); opacity: 0; transition: opacity 200ms ease; pointer-events: none; } .ds-card:hover .ds-card-glow { opacity: 1; } .ds-card-title { font-family: 'Manrope', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.03em; color: #e8e8ed; margin: 0 0 6px; } .ds-card-sub { font-family: 'Noto Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; color: #8888a0; margin: 0; }

components.name: Chip / Status Pill
components.description: Section badges and product status pills (LIVE, BETA, COMING SOON).
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; background: rgba(15,15,26,0.5); border: 1px solid #1e1e30; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 6px 12px; font-family: 'Noto Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #8888a0; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Form fields — glass fill, hairline border, violet focus.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1); border-radius: 12px; padding: 10px 16px; color: #e8e8ed; font-family: 'Noto Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; transition: border-color 150ms ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.3); } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #6c63ff; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #00d9ff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Nav Link
components.description: Uppercase tracked links; active state gets violet text on a faint violet wash.
components.html: HomeServices
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 4px; } .ds-nav-link { padding: 8px 12px; font-family: 'Noto Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: -0.01em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #e8e8ed; text-decoration: none; border-radius: 8px; transition: color 150ms ease, background 150ms ease; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: #ffffff; } .ds-nav-link.is-active { color: #6c63ff; background: rgba(108,99,255,0.1); } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #00d9ff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Custom Cursor
components.description: Signature: 6px violet dot + 36px ring that scales 1.33x over interactives. Transform-only.
components.css: .ds-cursor { position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; pointer-events: none; z-index: 9999; } .ds-cursor-dot { position: absolute; width: 6px; height: 6px; background: #6c63ff; border-radius: 50%; transform: translate(-50%,-50%); transition: transform 100ms ease; } .ds-cursor-ring { position: absolute; width: 36px; height: 36px; border: 1.5px solid #6c63ff; border-radius: 50%; transform: translate(-50%,-50%); transition: transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1), border-color 200ms ease, background 200ms ease; } .ds-cursor-ring.is-hovering { transform: translate(-50%,-50%) scale(1.33); border-color: rgba(108,99,255,0.4); background: rgba(108,99,255,0.05); }

components.name: Typing Indicator
components.description: Signature: three dots with a smooth ease-out lift. No bounce.
components.css: .ds-typing { display: flex; gap: 6px; padding: 10px 20px; background: #0f0f1a; border: 1px solid #1e1e30; border-radius: 16px; width: max-content; } .ds-typing-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: rgba(136,136,160,0.4); animation: dsTypingDot 1.2s cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1) infinite; } .ds-typing-dot:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: 150ms; } .ds-typing-dot:nth-child(3) { animation-delay: 300ms; } @keyframes dsTypingDot { 0%, 60%, 100% { transform: translateY(0); opacity: 0.35; } 30% { transform: translateY(-4px); opacity: 1; } }

narrative.overview: SILKDEV does not ask for permission. The site speaks from a position of advantage: a studio that watched the market commoditize and repositioned itself above the crowd, selling the shovels. Every surface is dark, deliberate, and sharp — no pastel optimism, no soft apology, no decorative warmth. The void background is the default state; violet signal and cyan reflex appear only where they mean something: an action, a live product, a decision point. Typography carries the confidence — Drystick's blocky uppercase display is the studio's voice, loud and unhurried — while Noto Sans body text stays clinical and readable underneath. Interaction is immediate: things press, glow on hover, and never linger. The system is layered, not shadowed. Depth comes from tonal surfaces and blurred glow blobs, not box shadows.
keyCharacteristics: Void-first: near-black backgrounds everywhere, surfaces slightly lighter, borders barely visible
Signal rarity: violet/cyan accents are scarce and purposeful, never decorative wallpaper
Uppercase voice: display type and labels shout in caps; body copy stays quiet and small
Immediate interaction: press feedback (scale 0.97), ease-out motion, hover glows
Craft details: custom cursor (dot + ring), grid-pattern overlays, glass surfaces

rules.name: The Signal Rule
rules.body: Accents cover at most ~15% of any screen. Their rarity is the point — when violet appears, it means "act here."

rules.name: The Void Rule
rules.body: Backgrounds are always darker than surfaces, surfaces darker than borders, borders darker than text. The hierarchy is: void → surface → border → text. Never invert it.

rules.name: The Uppercase Voice Rule
rules.body: Display and labels are uppercase; body copy is sentence case. The contrast between shout and whisper is the typographic personality.

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Cards and surfaces are flat at rest. Depth comes from tonal contrast and glow, not box shadows. The single violet glow is reserved for hover feedback.

dos: Do keep backgrounds in the void family (#0a0a14–#1a1a28); a page should read as one continuous dark field.
Do reserve Signal Violet for actionable/decision moments — buttons, active nav, focus.
Do use uppercase for display and labels, sentence case for body.
Do use glow blobs (blurred radial gradients) for depth; they're the system's shadow language.
Do press everything interactive (scale 0.97) — the site reacts immediately or not at all.
donts: Don't add warm colors, gradients with gold/orange warmth, or pastel tints anywhere in the chrome (product cards keep their own identity accents).
Don't use box shadows as primary elevation — tonal layering and glow only.
Don't set body text below 14px or above 65–75ch line length.
Don't uppercase body copy or long passages — uppercase is a display/label privilege.
Don't animate width/height/left/top — transform and opacity only.
